sampleArticles.title: Private Companies Are Now Gathering Weather Data for NOAA
sampleArticles.description: WindBorne Systems is one of several companies launching balloons, drones, buoys, and other devices to provide critical data to the beleaguered agency’s National Weather Service, but they can’t fill all the gaps.

sampleArticles.title: Why the US Is Racing to Build a Nuclear Reactor on the Moon
sampleArticles.description: NASA has set a 2030 deadline to build a 100-kilowatt nuclear reactor on the moon. It’s an ambitious but potentially achievable goal that could transform space exploration, experts tell WIRED.

sampleArticles.title: Eli Lilly’s Obesity Pill Shows Promising Weight Loss in New Results
sampleArticles.description: In an 18-month clinical trial of the experimental GLP-1 pill orforglipron, about 60 percent of people lost at least 10 percent of their body weight.
